title: 第3章 城隍真的是我老祖宗-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》
content:
第(1/3)页

    虽说吴姜向来吹嘘自己酒量过人，可此刻躺回床上，酒意混着困意还是缠上了脑子，晕乎乎间刚把手机插好充电，整个人就被铺天盖地的困意彻底裹了进去。

    正在他似梦非梦的时候，下一秒，吴姜感觉周遭的环境便骤然切换。

    夜风带着刺骨的凉意，吹得他后颈发毛。

    吴姜猛地睁眼，竟发现自己正站在苍名县城隍庙的大门外！和白天香火鼎盛、人声鼎沸的模样截然不同，此刻庙宇被浓得化不开的夜色裹着，檐角灯笼泛着青幽幽的微光，空气里没有半分檀香，只剩一股清冽又肃穆的阴寒气，渗得人骨头缝都发疼。

    “这……是做梦？”吴姜狠狠掐了自己大腿一把，清晰的痛感直冲天灵盖，让他彻底懵了，到底是不是在做梦，他也迷糊了，“难道是喝到假酒了？”

    此刻庙门大敞着，里头透出微弱的烛光，像是专门在等他上门。

    吴姜心提到了嗓子眼，嘴里碎碎念个不停：“老祖宗保佑，老祖宗救命，不管您是不是真的，这会儿您就是我亲老祖！”

    事到如今，管不了传说真假，先抱上“大腿”再说。

    他盯着敞开的大门，腿肚子直打颤，却也知道躲不过，只能缩着脖子、蹑手蹑脚地挪了进去。

    庙里静得能听见自己的心跳声，和白天所见的格局截然不同——主殿两侧竟多了好几间分殿，每间殿内都灯火摇曳，却连半个人影、半道鬼影都看不见，透着说不出的诡异。

    吴姜磨磨蹭蹭挪进主殿，只见殿中主位上坐着一位老者，面容清癯，身着绣着云纹的古代官袍，眉眼间自带威严，正垂眸看着他。

    吴姜心里一咯噔，求生欲瞬间拉满，没等对方开口，“噗通”一声就跪了下去，还麻利地磕了个头。

    “后辈吴姜，拜见老祖宗！祝您仙福永享，寿与天齐！” 嘴甜的本事此刻发挥得淋漓尽致。

    “咳……你这小子倒机灵，这会儿知道认祖宗了。” 老者的声音浑厚中带着几分戏谑，打破了殿内的肃穆。

    吴姜懵了一瞬，抬头时眼睛瞪得溜圆，满是不可置信：“您……您真的是我吴家先祖，苍名县城隍爷？”

    “你白天许愿，不是盼着老祖我给你托梦，让你日进斗金、美女环绕吗？我这就遂了你的愿，把你叫过来了。” 城隍爷语气平淡，却字字扎心。

    吴姜闻言，恨不得抽自己两大嘴巴子——让你丫的嘴贱！

    主位上的城隍爷看着他懊恼的模样，忍不住笑出了声，缓缓开口道：“老夫吴崇，大明朝永乐年间任职苍名县城隍，受乡民香火供奉，护一方百姓安宁。你是老夫第二十四代子孙，白天听了你那番‘豪言壮语’，便特意招你来此相认。”

    说最后一句时，他眼底的戏谑都快溢出来了。

    吴姜大脑瞬间宕机，从小到大被他当成笑料调侃的家族传说，居然是真的！他张了张嘴，半天发不出声音，就那么愣愣地跪着，眼神放空。

    城隍爷见状也不催促，轻笑一声后，语气渐渐郑重：“你是我吴氏后代里，少有的身负先天灵光之人，今日找你，是有桩好事托付予你。”

    “前段时间，酆都大帝见阳间反腐成效显著，便决意在地府也掀起一场清查整顿，这段时间清退了不少贪腐失职的阴司官吏，空出了不少职位。老夫也因镇守苍名县有功，不久后将升任府城隍，调离此地。”

    他话锋一转，目光灼灼地看向吴姜：“老夫给你两个选择。其一，可从老夫麾下的阴差做起，负责辖区内接引亡魂之事，基本没什么危险。”
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Although Wu Jiang had always boasted about his ability to drink, now that he was lying on the bed, the alcohol and sleepiness were still clinging to his brain. As soon as he plugged in his phone to charge, he was completely enveloped in the overwhelming sleepiness.

Just when he was not dreaming, the next second, Wu Jiang felt that the surrounding environment suddenly changed.

The night wind was bitingly cool, making the hair on the back of his neck tingle.

Wu Jiang opened his eyes suddenly and found that he was standing outside the gate of the Town God's Temple in Cangming County!It was completely different from the daytime when the incense was flourishing and the crowds were bustling. At this moment, the temple was shrouded in the thick darkness of night. The lanterns at the corners of the eaves were glowing with a faint green light. There was not a trace of sandalwood in the air, only a clear and solemn cold air, which seeped into the bones and made people ache.

"Is this... a dream?" Wu Jiang pinched his thigh hard, and the clear pain shot straight to Tianling Gai, making him completely confused. He was also confused as to whether he was dreaming or not. "Did he drink fake wine?"

At this moment, the temple door is wide open, and there is a weak candlelight inside, as if it is waiting for him to come.

Wu Jiang’s heart raised to her throat, and she kept mumbling: “Ancestor bless me, ancestor help me, no matter if you are true or not, you are my ancestor at this moment!”

At this point, we can’t care whether the legend is true or false, let’s hold on to the “leg” first.

He stared at the open door, his calves trembling, but he knew he couldn't escape, so he could only shrink his neck and move in quietly.

The temple was so quiet that you could hear your own heartbeat. The layout was completely different from what you saw during the day - there were several more branch halls on both sides of the main hall. The lights in each hall were flickering, but not even half a human figure or half a ghost could be seen. It was indescribably weird.

Wu Jiang slowly moved into the main hall and saw an old man sitting on the main seat in the hall. He had a pale face and was wearing an ancient official robe embroidered with cloud patterns. His eyebrows were majestic and he was looking down at him.

Wu Jiang's heart skipped a beat, and his desire to live was instantly overflowing. Before the other party could speak, he knelt down with a "pop" and kowtowed quickly.

"My descendant, Wu Jiang, pays homage to our ancestors! I wish you eternal blessings and a life as long as the heavens!" The ability to talk sweetly comes into full play at this moment.

"Ahem...you kid is so smart. Now you know how to recognize your ancestors." The old man's rich voice was filled with a hint of joking, breaking the solemnity in the hall.

Wu Jiang was stunned for a moment, and when he raised his head, his eyes were wide open, full of disbelief: "You...are you really the ancestor of my Wu family, the Lord God of Cangming County?"

"You made a wish during the day, didn't you hope that my ancestor would give you a dream, that you would make a lot of money every day and be surrounded by beautiful women? I have fulfilled your wish and called you here." The tone of the City God was calm, but every word was heartbreaking.

When Wu Jiang heard this, he wished he could slap himself in the face - you're so mean!

The City God in the main seat looked at his annoyed look and couldn't help but laugh out loud. He slowly said: "I, Wu Chong, served as the City God of Cangming County during the Yongle period of the Ming Dynasty. I was worshiped by the villagers and protected the peace of the people. You are the twenty-fourth generation descendant of me. After hearing your 'bold words' during the day, I specially invited you to come here to recognize me."

When he said the last sentence, the amusement in his eyes almost overflowed.

Wu Jiang’s brain suddenly shut down. The family legend that he had ridiculed as a joke since he was a child turned out to be true!He opened his mouth, but no sound came out for a long time. He just knelt down in a daze, his eyes empty.

Seeing this, the City God did not rush. After a chuckle, his tone gradually became more solemn: "You are one of the few descendants of my Wu family with innate aura. I am looking for you today because I have entrusted you with a good thing."

"Some time ago, Emperor Fengdu saw the remarkable results of anti-corruption in the Yang world, so he decided to launch an investigation and rectification in the underworld. During this period, many corrupt and derelict officials in the underworld were eliminated, leaving many positions vacant. I also have meritorious service in guarding Cangming County. I will be promoted to Fucheng Huang in the near future and will be transferred from here."

He changed the topic and looked at Wu Jiang with a burning gaze: "I give you two choices. One, you can start as a secret agent under me and be responsible for attracting the souls of the dead within the jurisdiction. There is basically no danger."
